msgs:
Love is sharing
the last cookie

I love you more
than coffee {o}

Hug me when
you get home

The best thing
that ever
happened to me

I want to grow
old with you

You're my sun,
even at night {y}

I miss you even
in the next room

Love is warming
the car for you
in winter

You still make
my heart race

With you the
kitchen is a
restaurant

I like you
more every day

You're my favorite
reason to smile

Just so you know:
you're loved {r}

Love is care
in small things

I can't wait
to see you

I love you even
with socks
on the floor

You make me want
to be better

While you're here,
all is well

Your smile is my
favorite view

With you it's
calm and warm

Our love grows
stronger every day

Love is looking
in the same
direction

Thanks for your
patience and love

Love is when
the tea is
already poured

My love for you
rises like
fresh dough

Together till
we're old and gray

Every day with
you is a holiday

Our hearts speak
the same language

I love you with
all my heart {r}

Every day with
you is a gift

Love you yesterday,
today
and tomorrow

Your voice is my
favorite music

Love is forgiving
a burnt dinner

Even traffic jams
are fun with you

Our home is
full of love

Love needs no words.
But: I love you

You're the meaning
of my days

I fall for
you every day

Your eyes are
my favorite view

I love you even
on Mondays

Any place is
paradise with you

Love is a warm tea
at the right moment

Coffee for two,
life for two {o}

Holding hands
is my
favorite place

My heart smiles
when you walk in

Your hand in mine,
all is right

My favorite place
is next to you

Thank you for
every ordinary day
